info.title: ANVIKSHA API
info.description:
ANVIKSHA is a database-backed knowledge publishing platform built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2.x, and JWT authentication.

**Question Deeper. Understand Better.**

### Authorization policy
- All create, update, and delete endpoints require a Bearer JWT.
- Only a post's or comment's author may modify or delete it.
- Existing resources owned by another user return `403 Forbidden`.
- Missing resources return `404 Not Found`.
- A deleted post deletes its comments through `ON DELETE CASCADE`.
- Users with existing content cannot be deleted (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`); no user-deletion endpoint is exposed.

Use `POST /login` to obtain a token, then click **Authorize** and paste it.

post.description: Requires authentication. A bookmark is unique per user and post; repeating the request is idempotent. An optional collection label can be supplied in the JSON body.

delete.description: Requires authentication. Removing a bookmark is idempotent.

patch.description: Requires authentication and an existing bookmark. Send a collection label, or null to move the saved post back to Unsorted.
